description: This file provides utility functions to create protobuf message objects for TensorBoard graph nodes, attributes, and tensor shapes, facilitating the construction of TensorFlow computational graph representations in Python.

classes.name: NodeDef
classes.description: Protobuf message class representing a TensorFlow node.

classes.name: AttrValue
classes.description: Protobuf message class representing a TensorFlow attribute value.

classes.name: TensorShapeProto
classes.description: Protobuf message class representing tensor shape information.

methods.name: dict[str,AttrValue] attr_value_proto(dtype: object, shape: Sequence[int] | None, s: str | None)
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with AttrValue objects matching a NodeDef's attr field, based on provided dtype, shape, and string values.

methods.name: TensorShapeProto tensor_shape_proto(outputsize: Sequence[int])
methods.description: Creates a TensorShapeProto object from a sequence of dimension sizes.

methods.name: NodeDef node_proto( name: str, op: str = "UnSpecified", input: list[str] | str | None = None, dtype: torch.dtype | None = None, shape: tuple[int, ...] | None = None, outputsize: Sequence[int] | None = None, attributes: str = "", )
methods.description: Constructs a NodeDef object with specified name, operation, inputs, data type, shape, and attributes.

ctags.name: attr_value_proto
ctags.pattern: /^def attr_value_proto(dtype: object, shape: Sequence[int] | None, s: str | None) -> dict[str, Att/
ctags.signature: (dtype: object, shape: Sequence[int] | None, s: str | None)

ctags.signature: ( name: str, op: str = "UnSpecified", input: list[str] | str | None = None, dtype: torch.dtype | None = None, shape: tuple[int, ...] | None = None, outputsize: Sequence[int] | None = None, attributes: str = "", )
